Usage: korext [options] [command]

Korext Command Line Interface - Enterprise Policy Enforcement

Options:
  -V, --version            output the version number
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  login [token]            Authenticate with the Korext platform using a
                           personal access token
  status                   Check current authentication and backend connection
                           status
  packs [options] <list>   List available policy packs from the server
  industries               List all supported industries and their associated
                           policy packs
  init [options]           Initialize a korext.json configuration file for your
                           project
  org-policy               Display the organisation governance policy for your
                           account
  enforce [options] [dir]  Statically analyze files in a directory against
                           Korext policies
  rules                    Rule definition management commands
  bundle                   Proof bundle management commands
  policy                   Local policy document processing commands
  watch [options] [dir]    Continuously enforce policies on file changes (live
                           development mode)
  help [command]           display help for command
